scene: You reach the clocktower catwalk among huge ticking cogs.
picture: Pixel art flat side-view of a clocktower interior catwalk. Far left features a gold valve on copper pipes. In the centre, the young Black woman in yellow raincoat, green boots, and red umbrella stands facing forward. To the right sits a goggled mechanical pigeon on the railing, and far right extends a wooden beam.
shown: A polished gold steam valve attached to copper pipes on the far left
A robotic pigeon wearing tiny brass goggles perched on a railing right
A narrow wooden maintenance beam extending into darkness on the far right

variants.scene: Steam hisses warmly as the giant clock gears turn above your yellow raincoat.
A mechanical pigeon watches you while {tune} hums with the ticking pendulum.
Lanterns glow softly along the metal bridge beneath the massive clock face.
